subject: math
name: Mathematics
title: Grade 10 Mathematics: Geometry
overview: Grade 10 Mathematics delivers advanced mathematical preparation, rigorous logical deduction, and complex modeling across algebraic, geometric, trigonometric, and analytical domains.
competencies: Construct formal deductive arguments, proofs, and mathematical models to solve real-world problems.
Analyze functions, coordinate systems, and algebraic structures with computational accuracy.
Apply advanced formulas, theorems, and mathematical transformations.
Communicate mathematical reasoning fluently using precise symbolic notation and graphical representations.

modules.title: Congruence, Proof, and Geometric Constructions
modules.description: Formalizing geometric proof, parallel lines with transversals, triangle congruence criteria (SAS, ASA, SSS), and compass/straightedge constructions.

topics.title: Geometric Definitions and Axiomatic Systems
topics.description: Establishing formal undefined terms (point, line, plane), definitions of angles, rays, and perpendicular lines.

topics.title: Rigid Motions and Triangle Congruence
topics.description: Defining transformations as functions on the plane and proving triangle congruence criteria.

topics.title: Proving Theorems About Lines and Angles
topics.description: Writing deductive two-column and flow proofs for vertical angles, parallel lines cut by transversals, and triangle angle sums.

modules.title: Similarity, Right Triangles, and Trigonometry
modules.description: Investigating dilations, proving triangle similarity criteria (AA, SAS, SSS), and defining right triangle trigonometric ratios (sine, cosine, tangent).

topics.title: Dilations and Triangle Similarity Proofs
topics.description: Verifying properties of dilations and proving that two triangles are similar when corresponding angles are equal.

topics.title: Right Triangle Trigonometric Ratios
topics.description: Defining sine, cosine, and tangent as ratios of right triangle side lengths, solving for unknown heights.

modules.title: Extending to Three Dimensions: Surface Area and Volume
modules.description: Explaining and applying formulas for circumference, area of circles, volume of cylinders, pyramids, cones, and spheres using Cavalieri's principle.

topics.title: Area of Sectors and Radians
topics.description: Deriving the formula for arc length and radian measure, and calculating areas of circular sectors.

topics.title: Volume of Prisms, Cylinders, Pyramids, and Cones
topics.description: Applying Cavalieri's principle and volume formulas to solve engineering and design problems.

modules.title: Connecting Algebra and Geometry Through Coordinates
modules.description: Using coordinate geometry to prove geometric theorems algebraically, deriving the equation of a circle, and working with parallel/perpendicular slopes.

topics.title: Coordinate Proofs and Distance Formula
topics.description: Using distance and slope formulas to prove properties of quadrilaterals (parallelograms, rectangles, rhombi).

topics.title: Equation of a Circle in the Coordinate Plane
topics.description: Deriving (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2 using the Pythagorean Theorem and completing the square.
